I will do this plot the way I can manage with the money I have. This land is rented, and for beans I do not want to spend cash on fertilizer when many of us here just plant after the rains and use seed we kept or got nearby. I will intercrop as usual, use my own family work, and if weeds become too much I will buy a little chemical to help because labor is not always enough. Irrigation I will not do because I depend on the rains.
